title: PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data, 2025 release
summary: This dataset contains model-based county estimates.
publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion, Division of Population Health

how_to_use.step: Run the bounded Philadelphia query to inspect a sample record.
caveats: Estimates are model-based; they cannot detect the effects of local interventions and should not be used for program or policy evaluation.
The 2025 release uses 2023 or 2022 BRFSS survey data; review confidence intervals and geographic boundaries before comparisons.
how_to_use.citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion, Division of Population Health. PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data, 2025 release.
